Australia Investigates Multiple Near-Miss Incidents at Sydney Airport

Australian authorities are investigating three separate incidents where aircraft came dangerously close to collision at Sydney Airport within a two-week period. The investigations are ongoing, with details on the specific nature of the near-misses and the aircraft involved not yet fully disclosed. The incidents have raised concerns about air traffic safety at one of Australia's busiest airports.
